correctness.rationale: Normalize the n+1-element finite MV-chain values to a,b,c∈{0,…,n}, ⊕=min(n,x+y), ⊙=max(0,x+y−n). For 0<a<n set t=n−a. The forward equation is exactly the union of four b,c regions: below threshold b+c≤t; two mixed regions with zero/minimal or n/maximal boundary; above threshold the diagonal b+c=2n−a. Summing yields (n³+30n²+5n+12)/6 forward triples; order-reversing De Morgan involution gives the identical dual count. Both equations hold on two full a=0,n layers plus boundary segments and exactly two interior diagonals, totaling 3n pairs per interior a and 5n²+n+2 overall. Exact probabilities divide by (n+1)³, giving 1/6 and 5/n asymptotics. Independent direct min/max enumeration for n=1,…,24 checked 105,624 triples and both exact counts. Finite enumeration corroborates but arbitrary n follows from disjoint case partition.
residual_risks: The denominator is (n+1)³ because n is the MV-chain denominator, not its number of points.
No claim concerning other algebras, nonuniform samples, or different weak-connective operations.
